channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Plano de Flávio por voto católico mira encontro com Frei Gilson e vice
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is developing strategies to attract Catholic voters, including a potential meeting with Frei Gilson and selecting a Catholic running mate, such as federal deputy Simone Marquetto. The plan also includes organizing a large event with religious leaders and influencers, despite Bolsonaro being evangelical.

item.title: Eleições de 2026 terão novo recorde de eleitoras mulheres
item.description: The 2026 elections are projected to set a new record for female voters, with women comprising 52.8% of the electorate according to TSE data from March — up from 50.8% in 2002 and 0.2 percentage points above 2022. There are currently 82.8 million registered female voters and 73.9 million male voters, with the Federal District having the highest proportion (54.2%) and Pará the lowest (50.8%). Presidents Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are actively courting this key demographic.

item.title: Falta 1 voto declarado para Messias ser aprovado na CCJ
item.description: Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Federal Court has 13 favorable and 8 opposed votes in the Senate's CCJ, needing just one more vote for approval. Of the 27 senators, five remain undeclared, with Cid Gomes and Rodrigo Pacheco leaning in favor, and Oriovisto Guimarães and Sérgio Moro (who switched to the PL) leaning against. Recent party shifts and position changes by senators like Eliziane Gama, Soraya Thronicke, and Rodrigo Pacheco have altered the dynamics.

item.title: Campanha de Haddad arma ofensiva em três frentes contra Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad's campaign, the PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, has defined three attack fronts against Governor Tarcísio de Freitas: toll roads (especially the 'free flow' model), public safety (focusing on perceived crime rise and lethal police operations), and the governor's relationship with inland mayors, which allies view as flawed.

item.title: Rejeição de mulheres a Lula e a Flávio está no mesmo nível
item.description: April 2026 polls show 54% of female voters reject both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally, signaling a decline in Lula’s female support following controversial, perceived as macho statements during his third term. Although Lula still leads among women in the first round, his advantage is negated by the combined support for Flávio and other candidates, with rising female indecision. This mirrors the 2022 dynamic, where women’s opposition to Bolsonaro propelled Lula to victory — but now, that advantage has eroded due to the deterioration of Lula’s long-cultivated image of moderation and empathy.

item.title: Juros altos e orçamento curto travam a reforma agrária, diz dirigente do MST
item.description: The national coordinator of the MST, João Paulo Rodrigues, criticizes the Lula government for insufficient progress on agrarian reform, stating only 10,000 families have been settled since 2023 — far below previous administrations. He attributes the stagnation to lack of funding, citing a need for R$15 billion against only R$500 million allocated, along with high interest rates, expansion of social programs, and low structural investment as key obstacles.

item.title: Lula participa do Fórum em Defesa da Democracia em Barcelona
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is attending the 4th Forum in Defense of Democracy in Barcelona, Spain, alongside leaders such as Pedro Sánchez (Spain), Gustavo Petro (Colombia), and Claudia Sheinbaum (Mexico). Launched in 2024, the forum aims to strengthen international cooperation in defense of democracy. During his European tour, Lula also participated in the Spain-Brazil Business Summit, signed agreements on critical minerals and gender-based violence and racism prevention, and proceeded to Germany on Sunday.

item.title: Viva Oscar Schmidt, o cestinha de ouro do Brasil
item.description: Acting President Geraldo Alckmin declared three days of official mourning for Oscar Schmidt, the legendary Brazilian basketball player known as 'Holy Hand'. Former President Lula also paid tribute, praising Schmidt's talent, dedication, and inspiration to generations. The text contrasts this recognition with the Bolsonaro government's pattern of withholding official tributes from public figures who did not align with its ideology.

item.title: ‘Eleições serão mais fáceis que em 2022′, diz Wellington Dias, ministro de Lula
item.description: Minister Wellington Dias admits the government needs to improve communication and organize its campaign better, but believes the 2026 election will be easier than in 2022. He highlights the strategy of attacking Flávio Bolsonaro’s inexperience as Lula’s main challenger and stresses the importance of regaining support in the Northeast, formerly the 'Red Belt', through visible infrastructure and public recognition. Dias also criticizes the inflation target as excessive and links income loss to debt and high interest rates.

item.title: Taxa das blusinhas, bets e apps: Governo Lula adere à política do ‘esqueça que já defendi isso’
item.description: The Lula government is attempting to distance itself from unpopular policies — including app worker regulation, the 'blusinhas tax,' and the sports betting crisis — by shifting responsibility to Congress to avoid electoral damage in 2026. The app workers' bill, despite being a campaign promise, was shelved after pushback from workers and internal assessment that the political cost would fall on the government. The 'blusinhas tax,' a 20% levy on international purchases under US$50, has been acknowledged as a political miscalculation due to its direct negative impact on consumers' purchasing power.

item.title: Reunión de líderes progresistas en Barcelona, en directo | Sheinbaum niega que hubiera una crisis diplomática con España por el sufrimiento causado en la conquista
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum denied that a diplomatic crisis exists with Spain over the recognition of suffering caused by Spanish conquistadors in what is now Mexico, stating no such crisis has ever occurred. She spoke at the IV Democracy Defense Meeting in Barcelona, alongside Brazilian President Lula da Silva, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, and Colombian President Gustavo Petro, who called the gathering a 'beacon for life' amid dangerous global disorder. The event coincided with the Global Progressive Mobilisation, bringing together progressive leaders to strategize against the rise of the far right.

item.title: Transferência de votos no 2º turno favorece Flávio Bolsonaro e isola Lula, aponta pesquisa
item.description: The Genial/Quaest presidential poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading in vote transfers from other candidates in a potential runoff against Lula (PT), indicating a strategic advantage for Bolsonaro’s camp. His ability to attract votes from opponents suggests he could consolidate non-PT support, while Lula struggles to build broader alliances ahead of a possible second round.

item.title: Renan Santos critica inquéritos para investigar postagens sobre Lula
item.description: Renan Santos, a pre-candidate for president from the Missão party, criticized the STF's opening of investigations against Lula's opponents over social media posts, citing his own PF investigation over statements about abortion in the SUS. He accused the government of being in 'desperation' due to declining polls and claimed the judiciary is acting with animus against bolsonarism, benefiting Flávio Bolsonaro as the main opposition figure.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, Brasil busca negócios na maior feira industrial do mundo, na Alemanha
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will visit Hannover, Germany, to attend Hannover Messe 2026, the world's largest industrial fair, where Brazil is the partner country. The agenda includes a meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, the 42nd Brazil-Germany Economic Meeting, and the expectation of signing ten agreements in areas such as defense, infrastructure, energy innovation, and bioeconomy. Sebrae will bring 190 Brazilian micro and small enterprises and startups to the event, which precedes the partial implementation of the Mercosul-EU agreement on May 1st.

item.title: Defensores de código de ética para o STF, Fachin e Cármen admitem desgaste após crise do Master e relatório de CPI
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin and Justice Cármen Lúcia acknowledged a crisis of confidence in the Judiciary due to suspicions linking ministers to the Banco Master scandal and recent clashes with the Legislature. Both support creating an ethical code for STF justices despite internal resistance, and criticized the Organized Crime CPI report that suggested indicting magistrates. Fachin stressed the crisis requires new solutions, not repeating old approaches.

item.title: Projeto orçamentário de 2027 reflete incúria fiscal
item.description: The Budget Guidelines Law Project (PLDO) for 2027, sent to Congress this week, projects public debt to rise from 79% of GDP in 2025 to 86% and 87.8% by 2027, up from 73.5% when Lula began his third term. The article criticizes the government’s fiscal stance as evidence of neglect, claiming the president ignores the need to adjust public accounts. Access to the full text requires a subscriber login.

item.title: Perto da eleição, ministros do STF vão da defensiva à ameaça
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes requested an investigation into Senator Alessandro Vieira for alleged abuse of authority after Vieira defended Mendes' indictment in the report of the Organized Crime CPI. Legal experts criticized the request, noting that parliamentarians enjoy constitutional immunity for opinions expressed in the exercise of their duties, and that Vieira’s report was rejected by the CPI, rendering his statements mere opinion without any abusive act of power.

item.title: Lula precisa dizer ao eleitor por que merece ficar
item.description: Lula must tell voters why he deserves to be re-elected, using an analogy with BBB, where participants must justify their staying in one minute. The author compares the show's elimination dynamic with electoral evaluation, emphasizing that the public's vote decides who stays. The column is exclusive to subscribers and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Em Barcelona, Lula participa de fórum em defesa da democracia neste sábado
item.description: President Lula participates in Barcelona in the 4th High-Level Meeting of the Democracy Forever Forum, an international event discussing the strengthening of democratic institutions amid the rise of authoritarian movements. He then travels to Germany to attend the opening of the Hannover Industrial Fair and the Brazil-Germany Economic Meeting, before proceeding to Portugal for official meetings with the prime minister and president.

item.title: Distribuidoras de combustível ameaçam ir à Justiça contra exposição de lucro e podem rejeitar subvenção de R$ 4 bi
item.description: Fuel distributors threaten legal action against the Lula government's requirement to disclose profit margins as a condition for accessing a subsidy of up to R$ 4.33 billion for diesel imports. The companies argue the measure violates commercial confidentiality and may reject the subsidy if the rule is not revised. The dispute highlights tensions over transparency in the energy sector and state intervention in pricing mechanisms.

item.title: Bolsonaro está apto para cirurgia no ombro, diz defesa ao STF
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told the STF that the former president is now medically cleared for right shoulder surgery, following improvement in his overall clinical condition, including recovery from bilateral pneumonia and respiratory symptoms. Despite progress, he continues to experience nighttime pain and functional impairment, with imaging confirming a high-grade lesion requiring arthroscopic intervention. The request is part of Execution Penalty 169, under Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and follows prior filings in April requesting similar medical treatment.

item.title: Veja quais signos mais venceram o BBB e quem “sai na frente” em 2026
item.description: The article explores how zodiac signs, particularly Sagittarius and Pisces, have historically had greater success in Big Brother Brazil, suggesting a possible astrological influence on the show's outcomes. Although not directly related to the 2026 elections, the content uses this analogy to generate engagement with themes of prediction and fate, common in entertainment-focused narratives.

item.title: Flávio critica voto “sem pé nem cabeça” de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Justice Alexandre de Moraes' vote to condemn his brother Eduardo Bolsonaro, calling the decision 'without sense', 'bizarre', and 'illegal'. He linked the ruling to what he described as a 'farce' against Jair Bolsonaro and an unlawful investigation triggered by a social media post.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem evolução clínica ‘satisfatória’ e ‘melhora discreta’ no pulmão, dizem médicos ao STF
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro shows satisfactory clinical evolution and discreet improvement in his left lung, according to a medical report submitted to the STF, though he still experiences episodes of pain, muscle fatigue, and imbalance due to medication. His physiotherapy was disrupted by an eight-hour hiccup episode, but his defense maintains the request for right shoulder surgery and continues clinical monitoring. Bolsonaro remains under house arrest granted by Minister Alexandre de Moraes for post-hospitalization recovery.

item.title: 'Bizarro e ilegal', diz Flávio sobre voto de Moraes para condenar Eduardo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' vote condemning his brother, former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro, in a defamation case brought by federal deputy Tabata Amaral. Flávio called the decision 'bizarre and illegal,' arguing the ruling was politically motivated and unlawful.

item.title: Lula critica Bets e diz querer regulação da redes sociais durante a eleição
item.description: President Lula criticized online sports betting (bets) and called for stricter regulation of social media during elections. He made the remarks alongside Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez during a press conference, following a Quaest poll showing 29% of Brazilians engage in online betting.

item.title: PDT aciona STF para anular eleição de Douglas Ruas na Alerj
item.description: The PDT filed a petition with the STF to annul the election of Douglas Ruas as president of the Alerj, citing irregularities in the vote. The party also requests a new secret-ballot vote and Ruas’s removal from office.

item.title: A enxurrada de startups e PMEs brasileiras na feira de Hannover
item.description: Sebrae will take 190 Brazilian micro, small enterprises and startups to Hannover Messe 2026, the world’s leading industrial technology fair, with Brazil as the official partner country and President Lula confirmed to attend. The mission aims to expand export opportunities and international insertion for small businesses, highlighting companies such as Easypro Tech, which develops industrial time-analysis software, and Biosolvit, focused on sustainability and circular economy solutions.

item.title: Gonet é contra livrar Roberto Jefferson de multa no STF
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet advised Minister Alexandre de Moraes that Roberto Jefferson should not be exempt from the STF-imposed fine, but that the payment should be made in equal monthly installments. Gonet argued that the defense failed to satisfactorily prove Jefferson’s inability to pay, given the updated fine of R$ 972,600. Moraes’ order for Jefferson to pay within ten days stands, with judicial enforcement possible if not complied with voluntarily.

item.title: ‘Sua dedicação elevou o nome do País’, diz Lula; veja reações à morte de Oscar Schmidt
item.description: President Lula mourned the death of Oscar Schmidt, a Brazilian basketball legend, praising his dedication, talent, and love for the national team, and highlighting the 1987 Pan-American Games victory over the U.S. as a symbolic moment. Other authorities, including Vice President Alckmin, Senate President Alcolumbre, and Chamber President Motta, paid tribute, emphasizing his sporting legacy and global impact.

item.title: Oscar Schmidt tentou carreira política e sonhou com a Presidência
item.description: Oscar Schmidt, former basketball star, entered Brazilian politics in the 1990s, running for the São Paulo Senate in 1990 and losing to Eduardo Suplicy in 1998. In a 2025 interview, he revealed his Senate bid was part of a larger plan to run for President of Brazil after spending 13 years in Europe. Prior to the Senate race, he served as municipal secretary of Sports, Leisure, and Recreation in São Paulo (1997–1998) under Mayor Celso Pitta.

item.title: Governo federal decreta luto de 3 dias pela morte de Oscar Schmidt
item.description: Acting President Geraldo Alckmin declared three days of official mourning for the death of Oscar Schmidt, Brazilian basketball legend, at age 68. Lula also expressed sorrow, praising Schmidt as a model of determination, talent, and love for the national team.

item.title: Lula lamenta morte de Oscar Schmidt e celebra legado no basquete
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mourned the death of Oscar Schmidt, a basketball legend, praising his legacy as a symbol of talent, perseverance, and love for the Brazilian national team. Lula said Schmidt united the country around basketball courts and inspired generations of athletes. The 68-year-old former player died after being hospitalized for sudden illness, with a known history of a brain tumor diagnosed in 2011.

item.title: RJ: Douglas Ruas e governador interino se reúnem após eleição da Alerj
item.description: Douglas Ruas (PL), newly elected president of the Rio de Janeiro State Legislature (Alerj), met with interim governor Ricardo Couto to affirm his commitment to institutional normalcy. He aims to dialogue with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) regarding the state’s succession line, as Couto’s continued tenure blocks Ruas from assuming the interim governorship. Ruas criticized ongoing institutional interinities and said Alerj’s legal office will notify the STF of his election to prompt a reevaluation of the succession.

item.title: Plínio diz que governo trava PEC da autonomia do BC e apresenta novo parecer
item.description: Senator Plínio Valério (PSDB-AM), rapporteur of the Central Bank autonomy PEC, presented a new opinion stating that the federal government does not intend to advance the proposal in 2026 due to the electoral context. The revised text consolidates adjustments made over a year, including reclassifying the BC as a 'public entity of special nature' to eliminate private law ambiguities, increasing articles from 8 to 10, strengthening governance, granting the BC authority over its own remuneration, pension management, and budget control — subject to CMN and Senate approval — and authorizing interventions during financial crises.

item.title: Políticos lamentam morte de Oscar Schmidt
item.description: Politicians mourned the death of Oscar Schmidt, former basketball player known as 'Holy Hand,' emphasizing his significance to Brazilian and global sports. Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and other officials praised his career, noting his brain cancer diagnosis in 2011 and nearly three decades of play for clubs including Palmeiras, Sírio, Corinthians, Flamengo, and European teams.

item.title: Acórdão do TSE não define modelo de eleição-tampão no RJ
item.description: The TSE ruling that made former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) ineligible did not specify whether the interim election for the state mandate will be direct or indirect. The decision on the model is pending analysis at the STF. The case concerns the state succession following Castro’s ineligibility.

item.title: Lula/X: Oscar Schmidt é exemplo de obstinaçăo, talento e de amor ŕ camisa da seleçăo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva paid tribute to the late basketball legend Oscar Schmidt, who died at 68, calling him an example of persistence, talent, and love for the national team. The message was posted on X (formerly Twitter) on Friday, the 17th.

item.title: Flávio aparece em vídeo ao lado de assessor de Marçal que socou marqueteiro do PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) appeared in a video alongside Nahuel Medina, Pablo Marçal's aide who assaulted PL's campaign strategist Duda Lima during a 2024 electoral debate. Recorded in Alphaville, Flávio praised Medina and offered entrepreneurial advice, while Medina admitted his reaction was impulsive and intends to personally apologize to Lima.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest indica o principal problema para Lula e os motivos para avanço de Flávio
item.description: The Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, with Lula leading 37% to 32% in the first round. The government’s 52% disapproval and negative economic perception — despite positive macro indicators — are Lula’s main hurdles, as voters don’t feel financial improvement. Flávio Bolsonaro gains by capitalizing on government weariness and the perception that social programs are no longer electoral differentiators.

item.title: FLÁVIO BOLSONARO ARTICULA COM PABLO MARÇAL E MIRA FORÇA DIGITAL PARA AS ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is collaborating with Pablo Marçal to build a digital force for the 2026 elections, aiming to expand his online presence and electoral mobilization. The strategy leverages Marçal’s expertise in digital marketing and social media engagement to strengthen the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: Presidente Lula e Ministério do Esporte homenageiam Oscar Schmidt: 'Maior ídolo da história do basquete brasileiro'
item.description: President Lula and the Ministry of Sports paid tribute to Oscar Schmidt, the legendary Brazilian basketball player who passed away at 68, honoring him as the greatest idol in Brazilian basketball history and one of the sport’s all-time top scorers. Lula highlighted Schmidt’s perseverance, talent, and dedication to the national team, while the Ministry emphasized his remarkable career totals — 49.737 points (second-highest in global basketball history) and 7.693 for Brazil — along with his gold medal at the 1987 Pan American Games and appearances in five Olympic Games from 1980 to 1996.

item.title: Malufista, Oscar Schmidt concorreu ao Senado e sonhou com a Presidência
item.description: Oscar Schmidt, Brazilian basketball idol, entered politics in 1998 as a Senate candidate for the PPB (now PP), backed by Paulo Maluf and strategist Duda Mendonça. Although he came close to winning, he lost to Eduardo Suplicy (PT). Years later, he revealed his ambition was to use the Senate as a stepping stone to the presidency.

item.title: PDT nacional aciona STF para anular eleição na Alerj que elegeu Douglas Ruas como presidente
item.description: The national PDT has filed a petition with the STF to annul the election that chose Douglas Ruas (PL) as president of the Alerj, citing interference from drug trafficking and militias and demanding a secret ballot. The party seeks Ruas’s immediate removal until a new vote is held under secret ballot rules, arguing that the STF has already signaled favor toward secret voting in indirect or sensitive elections.

item.title: Boulos diz que relator de PL dos apps cedeu a lobby de plataformas
item.description: Guilherme Boulos accused rapporteur Augusto Coutinho of yielding to platform lobbying from iFood and Uber by rolling back worker protections in a revised version of the PLP 152/2025 bill. The Lula government opposes the R$ 8.50 per ride floor, advocating for R$ 10 plus a per-kilometer addition, aligned with worker demands. Boulos denied a rift between the government and app workers, stating both oppose the current bill and that the government has expanded dialogue with unions, local associations, and worker movements.

item.title: Bolsonaro tem “boa evolução do quadro pulmonar e digestivo”, diz médico
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro has shown good progress in his pulmonary and digestive condition, according to a medical report sent to the STF, with improvement in symptoms such as fatigue, reflux, and shortness of breath, along with increased physical stamina.

item.title: Ministro defende projeto do governo pelo fim da escala 6x1 e diz que reduzir para 36 horas é 'irresponsabilidade'
item.description: Labor Minister Luiz Marinho defended the government's bill to end the 6x1 work scale, stating that an immediate reduction to 36 weekly hours would be irresponsible. He argued that Brazil's economy can sustain a more gradual reduction to 40 hours per week, as proposed by the executive.

item.title: O que pensam os eleitores sobre a suposta ‘moderação’ de Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo a Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll reveals 45% of voters do not see Flávio Bolsonaro as more moderate than his family, compared to 39% who do. For Lula, there is a technical tie: 42% view him as more moderate than the PT, while 42% hold the opposite view. Ronaldo Caiado is seen as the most moderate candidate by only 20%, with 39% disagreeing and 41% undecided.

item.title: ‘Estamos imersos em uma crise’, diz o presidente do STF
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Minister Edson Fachin warned that the Brazilian Judiciary is immersed in an institutional crisis marked by distrust and polarization, noting that judicial actions perceived as political erode public trust. He emphasized the need to recognize and confront this crisis with new approaches, avoiding repeated ineffective solutions. The statement comes amid internal tensions in the Court, including attempts to indict ministers by the Organized Crime CPI and investigations linked to Banco Master.

item.title: “Vamos ter mais um ministro censurador no STF?”, questiona Deltan
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol criticized the extrajudicial notice issued by the AGU, at the request of Deputy Erika Hilton, against journalists and influencers over publications about the so-called 'Misogyny Bill,' calling it persecution and censorship. He questioned whether AGU Chief Minister Jorge Messias is becoming a 'censoring minister' at the STF. The article was published by O Antagonista.
